name: Toaru Onna Senshi no Shuudan Mensetsu -Onna Senshi to Shite Orc ya Hydra to Tatakatta Keiken o Onsha de Ikaseru to Omoi Shibou Itashimashita-
original_name: とある女戦士の集団面接 -女戦士としてオークやヒドラと戦った経験を御社で活かせると思い志望いたしました-
source:
—I want to be of use at your company, as someone with experience fighting orcs and hydras as a female warrior. 

Someone who came to the mass interview for a major corporation was a “Female Warrior” who had once fought monsters as a hero. Female Warrior had a past where she had been defeated by monsters and confined in an orc village. 

The main character interviewer asks Female Warrior all sorts of questions, albeit half in disbelief. 
—Orcs are a fairly strong race, don't you sometimes lose? 
“Yes. Sometimes, I lose.” 
—How is it that you were able to stay safe even after losing? 
”Orc men eat human men, but women are used as an outlet for their sexual desires.” 
―S-So, you've had sex with orcs over and over again, is that right?
”Yes, that's how it is.” 

The woman warrior's mouth indignantly recounts the records of her days being inhumanely treated. Could MC possibly ask her what happened in the past during the mass interview?
And will the woman warrior be able to get a job safely?! Everything depends on the question of the main character, the interviewer!

[Translated from DLsite]
translation:
——我想在贵公司发挥作用，作为一名拥有与兽人和九头蛇战斗经验的女战士。

来参加大企业集体面试的，是一位曾经以英雄身份与怪物战斗的“女战士”。女战士有一段被怪物击败并被囚禁在兽人村庄的过去。

主角采访者问女战士各种各样的问题，尽管有些难以置信。
——兽人是一个相当强大的种族，你不是有时会失败吗？
“是的。有时候，我会输。” 
——怎么输了之后还能安然无恙呢？
“兽人男人吃人类男人，而女人则被用作性欲的发泄口。” 
——所以、那么，你一次又一次地和兽人发生性关系，是吗？
“是啊，就是这样。” 

女战士的口中愤慨地讲述着自己当年被非人对待的记录。MC能不能在大众采访的时候问她以前发生了什么？
而女战士能否顺利找到工作呢？！一切都取决于主角——面试官的问题！
